'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Matthew Ulstad LS Ewok Log Jam''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Ulstad]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ewok Log Jam]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
